purpose: Keep independently documented event/target HEC-HMS configurations and compare multiple hydrologically compatible hypotheses at forecast time, without assuming a universal parameterization or equating calibration fit with forecast skill.

targets.name: Santa Tereza
targets.notes: RNA/eventwise evidence exists; HEC discharge library waits on reconciled target Q/rating-curve evidence.

targets.name: Triunfo
targets.notes: checkpoint only; does not define G040 spatial domain

selector.weighting: Similarity ranking only; these weights are not calibrated probabilities or measured model skill.
selector.fallback: Multi-event model stays in the research comparison roster, NOT a universally validated default forecast.
selector.minimum_evidence: Historical fingerprint AND target-specific parameter row AND observed-Q coverage/gap/rain spatial quality audit; independent replay required before live use.
selector.target_event_exclusion: pseudo-operational replay must exclude the target event from its candidate library and may only use observations available at t0
selector.online_recalibration: optional research arm; may use observations only up to t0 and must be separately benchmarked
selector.operational_selection_policy: Require independently validated skill for transferred events plus fresh rain/Q conditions; until then output a research shortlist, not an authorized production parameter choice.

confidence.high: top analog close and clearly separated from alternatives, all critical features available
confidence.medium: usable analogs exist but distances are similar or some features are missing
confidence.low: no close analog, weak target library, or conflicting upstream state; use robust fallback/ensemble

no_single_parameter_rule: Do not replace the eventwise library with one basin-wide parameter set. Multiple configurations for different flood regimes are primary; a common fit is only a comparator. During an event, compare several candidates, their valid data windows and uncertainty.

scenario_regimes.policy: Categories are diagnostic hypotheses, not manually assigned labels or guarantees of analog fitness.
